title: Ireland – E-learning services – TR5866 A Single Supplier Framework Agreement Digital Learning Design, Development and Maintenance Services pursuant to a framework agreement
description: The Contracting Entity intends to procure a Digital Learning Design, Development and Maintenance Services framework for the provision of specialist digital learning services, including instructional design, eLearning development, accessibility reviews, project management and associated support services. The successful tenderer will be required to work collaboratively with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and stakeholders to design, develop, review, test and deliver digital learning content from initial onboarding through to final approval and provision of SCORM-compliant outputs. The supplier will be expected to provide a structured and transparent development methodology, supported by appropriate governance, project management, universal design principles including accessibility, quality assurance and stakeholder engagement processes. It is proposed that the Framework will include (non-exhaustive list – high level scope): Create engaging, accessible and effective digital learning that keeps learner needs, content and learning objectives central to the design. Examples of digital learning topics and types include: Policy, process or compliance learning Systems, technical or operational training Bite-sized learning, such as microlearning, video or animation Develop digital learning materials using the ADDIE (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation and Evaluation) framework, ensuring learning objectives, activities and assessments align with Bloom’s Taxonomy and the needs of the target audience. Use purposeful interactive approaches to enhance learner engagement. Apply Universal Design for Learning (UDL) and accessibility by design principles throughout, ensuring compliance with WCAG 2.2, EN 301 549 and ESB accessibility requirements, and meeting accessibility best practices. Ensure all interactive elements are accessible, usable and support diverse learner needs, undertaking additional development where required to meet accessibility requirements. Undertake accessibility testing as part of the design, development and quality assurance process, using appropriate testing methods and tools, and remediate identified accessibility issues prior to final delivery and approval. Provide appropriate coaching, guidance and instructional design support to SMEs within the business. Project manage the end-to-end development of digital learning solutions, from the business’s SME onboarding to final delivery, including appropriate project planning, timelines, milestones, review stages, change management and stakeholder approval/sign-off. Provide user friendly collaboration tools that enable SMEs to review content, give feedback, track changes and monitor progress. Apply internal governance and quality assurance controls to ensure all deliverables meet ESB’s scope, requirements, timelines and quality standards. Provide access to a library of pre-existing digital learning modules on standard or commonly required topics (e.g. data protection, cybersecurity, health and safety, compliance or similar). Where appropriate, these modules should be capable of reasonable customisation to incorporate ESB branding, accessibility requirements and organisation-specific information. Digital learning content must be developed using a recognised, globally adopted authoring tool (e.g. Articulate 360 or equivalent). Provide all content in a SCORM-compliant format. Ensure compatibility with ESB’s current Learning Management System (SuccessFactors) on desktop, mobile and tablet devices. Provide access to a dedicated team with the skills and capacity required to deliver services to ESB, including an ESB Account Lead, Instructional Designers, eLearning Developers, QA/Accessibility Specialists, Project Managers and additional creative team e.g. Graphic Designers/ Illustrators and Animators.

title: Germany – Building construction work – Stadt Bochum: Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer Grundschule in der Vöde, Castroper Str. 235
description: Die Stadt Bochum (nachfolgend "Auftraggeber") steht als Schulträger vor der Herausforderung, dem stetig wachsenden Raumbedarf aufgrund der steigenden Schulanmeldungen im Bochumer Stadtgebiet zu entsprechen. In diesem Zusammenhang herrscht - neben dem Erfordernis an Sanierungs- und Erhaltungsmaßnahmen bereits bestehender Schulgebäude - ein erheblicher Bedarf an der Schaffung neuer Sport- und Lernräume. Dabei ist der Auftraggeber nach dem Schulgesetz verpflichtet, Schulentwicklungsplanung zu betreiben. Zur Erfüllung dieser ihr gesetzlich obliegenden Pflicht plant der Auftraggeber dem wachsenden Raumbedarf im Rahmen eines umfassenden Schulbau- und Schulmodernisierungsprogramm zu begegnen. Dieses beinhaltet erforderliche Neubau-, Umbau- und Sanierungsmaßnahmen für 27 schulische Einrichtungen. Das Programm umfasst dabei alle Schularten und bezieht sich auf Grund-, Förder- und weiterführende Schulen. Eingebettet in dieses Schulbauprogramm soll nun die Erweiterung und der Umbau der Grundschule in der Vöde, Castroper Str. 235, 44791 Bochum erfolgen. Die bauliche Erweiterung sowie der Umbau der Grundschule in der Vöde nebst vorgelagertem Rückbau der Bestandsbauung soll durch einen Totalunternehmer / Totalübernehmer erfolgen. Die Grundschule in der Voede ist eine zweizügige Schule im Stadtteil Grumme. Die vorhandene Schüleranzahl von ca. 235 SuS (SJ 2026/27) wird bis zum Schuljahr 2030/31 auf prognostizierte 240 SuS anwachsen. Auf dem Grundstück befindet sich das Schulgebäude (ca. 468 m²), eine Trafostation (ca. 65 m²), eine Turnhalle (ca. 565 m²), die ehemalige Hausmeisterwohnung, die nun als OGS genutzt wird (ca. 132 m²) und ein an die Halle angebautes weiteres OGS-Gebäude (ca. 195 m²). Die Schulhoffläche beträgt ca. 2.100 m². Die geplante Maßnahme soll in drei Schritten realisiert werden: Schritt 1: Umbau Computerraum zu einem Klassenraum - bereits erfolgt; Ein Computerraum, der nicht mehr benötigt wurde, wurde zu einem Klassenraum umgebaut. Schritt 2: Containeranlage als zusätzlicher Klassenraum - bereits erfolgt; Ein Container vor dem Hauptgebäude an der Castroper Straße bietet Platz für einen weiteren Raum. Schritt 3: Rückbau des bestehenden Anbaus an die Turnhalle (OGS), Neubau und Umbau auf dem Schulhof (SJ 2030/31); Entlang der westlichen Grundstücksgrenze ist die Errichtung eines dreigeschossigen Neubaus vorgesehen. Da die nutzbare Schulhoffläche während der Bauphase erheblich eingeschränkt wird, soll der bestehende Anbau an die Turnhalle (Räumlichkeiten der OGS) vor der Ausführung des Neubaus zurückgebaut werden. Die entsprechenden Räume sollen im zweiten Obergeschoss des Neubaus untergebracht werden. Nach Abschluss der Neubauarbeiten erfolgen die erforderlichen Umbaumaßnahmen im Bestandsgebäude.

title: Denmark – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Udbud af parallelle rammeaftaler om totalrådgivning
description: fsb ønsker at indgå en rammeaftale om teknisk rådgivning og bistand som totalrådgivning i forbindelse med ustøttede renoveringsprojekter. Rammeaftalen vil blive tildelt fem leverandører (dvs. fem parallelle rammeaftaler). Tildeling af de konkrete opgaver vil ske gennem et miniudbud med relativt korte frister. Bilag 9 indeholder en oversigt over de projekter, som fsb på nuværende tidspunkt forventer at konkurrenceudsætte under de parallelle rammeaftaler, herunder forventet udbudsdato og forventet håndværkerudgift for hvert projekt. Som det fremgår af bilag 9, forventes de parallelle rammeaftaler at omfatte ustøttede renoveringsprojekter af varierende størrelse og kompleksitet – fra mindre, afgrænsede opgaver som udskiftning af vinduer og døre til større renoveringsprojekter – men ingen af projekterne er helhedsplaner. Oversigten udtrykker fsb’s forventede pipeline og er ikke bindende for fsb. fsb forventer, at der vil forekomme yderligere projekter under de parallelle rammeaftalers varighed udover de i bilag 9 angivne. For en nærmere beskrivelse af rammeaftaleudbuddet henvises til udbudsmaterialet i sin helhed. Man kan læse nærmere om fsb’s renoveringsprojekter på https://www.fsb.dk/nybyggeri-og-renovering/renovering/

Gegenstand des Auftrags sind die Planung, Lieferung, Errichtung und Inbetriebnahme einer vollständig betriebsbereiten Ladeinfrastruktur als einheitlicher Gesamtauftrag. Zusätzlich sind optionale Service- und Wartungsleistungen vorgesehen. Das Last- und Lademanagementsystem (LLMS) wird separat beschafft. Die Vergabe erfolgt als Lieferauftrag im Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb nach der Sektorenverordnung (SektVO). Eine Aufteilung in Lose erfolgt nicht.

Palveluntuottajan kanssa tehdään toistaiseksi voimassa oleva sopimus siten, että sopimuskauden arvioitu alkamisajankohta on kevät 2027. SUEK arvioi, että dopingnäytteiden kuljetuksista yli 90 % kohdistuu Suomen sisällä Helsingissä sijaitsevaan laboratorioon. Loput kuljetuksista toimitetaan muualle Eurooppaan. Selvyyden vuoksi todetaan, että SUEK tilaa tarjouspyynnön mukaisia kuljetuspalveluita tosiasiallisen tarpeensa mukaan. SUEK ei sitoudu sopimuskauden aikana tiettyihin tilausmääriin, eikä sopimus tuota valitulle palveluntuottajalle yksinoikeutta tarjota kuljetuspalveluita SUEKille. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä.

title: PSA Profischule Campus - Haus A - Holzinnentüren
description: Die Profilschule bildet mit der Mensa und der Sporthalle sowie den Sportanlagen das Schulzentrum. Es wurde zwischen den Jahren 1963 und 1971 erbaut, mehrfach erweitert und lange Zeit von einer Realschule genutzt. Mit dem Auslaufen der Realschule am 31.7.2016 nutzt die neue Schulform (Profilschule) die ehemaligen Gebäude. Um den Profilschulstandort in Ascheberg zu konzentrieren, wird die ehem. Hauptschule in Herben aufgegeben. Dafür müssen die Bestandsgebäude erweitert, umgebaut und saniert werden. Der neue Standort wird aus drei Gebäuden bestehen (Haus A (2), Haus B (3) und Haus C (1)) plus einem Wirtschaftsgebäude in leichter Bauweise. Haus A (2) wird nach Abschluss der Maßnahme ein saniertes Bestandsgebäude sein, Haus C (1) und Haus B (3) jeweils ein Neubau.

title: Vybavení nové kavárny II.
description: Předmětem plnění této veřejné zakázky malého rozsahu bude dodávka a montáž vybavení nové kavárny v budově sídla zadavatele, a to v souladu s požadavky a projektem podrobněji specifikovanými ve výzvě k předložení cenové nabídky a v jejích přílohách. Požadované plnění sestává zejména z chladících a mrazících zařízení, nerezového vybavení (regály a police, pracovní stoly, mycí stoly, mycí stoly vč. dřezů a baterií apod.), pecí, myčky, výrobníku sody, výrobníku ledu, výrobníku „hotdogů“ atd. Detailní popis všech dodávaných položek zařízení je obsažen ve vzorové Kupní smlouvě, která tvoří Přílohu č. 1 výzvy a v jejím rámci pak konkrétně v její příloze 1 – Dispozici provozu (nákres rozmístění technologie v prostorách nové kavárny) a v příloze 2 – Položkovém rozpočtu, obsahujícím rovněž veškeré požadované (nepodkročitelné) technické parametry jednotlivých položek zařízení. Součástí předmětu plnění veřejné zakázky, kromě dodání jednotlivých položek zařízení dle technické specifikace – dispozice provozu a položkového rozpočtu, bude dále poskytnutí s dodáním technologie souvisejících služeb, zejména přesné zaměření místa plnění před výrobou/obstaráním jednotlivých položek zařízení, a to v případě potřeby i opakovaně, zpracování dílenské (výrobní) dokumentace (je-li relevantní), uskladnění zařízení „u vybraného dodavatele“ či na jiném bezpečném místě na potřebnou dobu do okamžiku dopravy a instalace zařízení na místo plnění, dále balení a doprava jednotlivých položek zařízení na místo plnění, nastěhování, instalace zařízení, včetně veškerých elektromontážních, instalatérských (zejm. voda, odpady) a dalších souvisejících prací, uvedení kompletní technologie do provozu, provedení (zajištění) veškerých potřebných souhlasů, povolení a revizí nezbytných k řádnému provozu technologie v souladu s platnou legislativou a technickými normami, likvidace odpadů, zaškolení pracovníků zadavatele s obsluhou zařízení, dodání návodů k veškerým zařízením v českém jazyce (v tištěné podobě i v digitální podobě, video návod základního ovládání) apod.

title: Produktion, Personalisierung und versandfertige Bereitstellung von elektronischen Gesundheitskarten sowie von PIN-/PUK-Briefen
description: Gegenstand der Vergabe sind die für die beteiligten Krankenkassen jeweils erforderlichen Leistungen zur Produktion, Personalisierung, sicheren Datenverarbeitung, Konfektionierung und versandfertigen Bereitstellung elektronischer Gesundheitskarten (eGK) sowie zur Produktion und versandfertigen Bereitstellung der zugehörigen PIN-/PUK-Briefe. Die zu erbringenden Leistungen für die eGK beziehen sich zunächst auf eGK der Spezifikation eGK G2.1, umfassen aber auch die optionale rPVC-Ausführungsvariante sowie sämtliche während der Vertragslaufzeit von der einzelnen Krankenkasse freigegebenen physischen Nachfolgegenerationen der eGK. Die Leistungen für die versandfertige Bereitstellung der eGK umfassen zudem das von der jeweiligen Krankenkasse optional aktivierbare maschinelle Beifügen eines Hauptflyers zu den im jeweiligen technischen Produktionsauftrag entsprechend gekennzeichneten Kartenbegleitschreiben. Bei gesonderter Aktivierung kann zusätzlich genau ein kassenindividueller Zusatzflyer ausschließlich gemeinsam mit dem Hauptflyer beigefügt werden. Bei Beginn der Leistungserbringung ist der Hauptflyer der Organspendeflyer. Die Leistungen für die PIN-/PUK-Briefe umfassen – je nach konkretem Leistungsabruf der einzelnen Krankenkasse – auch die daten- und drucktechnische Umsetzung für die sichere Zustellung mittels Zustellident. Gesellschafter der IKK eGK-Beschaffung 2026 GbR sind die folgenden Krankenkassen: 1. BundesInnungskrankenkasse Gesundheit, kurz: BIG direkt gesund, Markgrafenstraße 22, 10117 Berlin; 2. IKK Brandenburg und Berlin, Ziolkowskistraße 6, 14480 Potsdam; 3. IKK gesund plus, Umfassungsstraße 85, 39124 Magdeburg; 4. IKK – Die Innovationskasse (IK), Überseeboulevard 5, 20457 Hamburg; 5. IKK classic, Tannenstraße 4b, 01099 Dresden; 6. IKK Südwest, Europaallee 3-4, 66113 Saarbrücken; 7. KNAPPSCHAFT, Knappschaftstraße 1, 44799 Bochum; 8. Sozialversicherung für Landwirtschaft, Forsten und Gartenbau (SVLFG), Weißensteinstraße 70-72, 34131 Kassel. Die beteiligten Krankenkassen sind jeweils Körperschaften des öffentlichen Rechts. Mit der Zuschlagserteilung kommen unmittelbar unbefristete Leistungsverträge zwischen dem Auftragnehmer und den einzelnen Krankenkassen zustande. Diese Verträge begründen fortlaufende Leistungs- und Vergütungspflichten im Sinne eines Dauerschuldverhältnisses. Die spätere Übermittlung der Daten für die einzelnen zu erstellenden Gesundheitskarten und PIN-/PUK-Briefe bestimmt lediglich Menge, Inhalt und Ausführungszeitpunkt der bereits vertraglich geschuldeten Leistungen. Hierbei handelt es sich nur um „Produktionsaufträge“ in einem technischen Sinne, die weder einen gesonderten Auftrag noch einen Einzelvertrag begründen. Die regelmäßige Produktion und die sonstige laufende Leistungserbringung beginnen am 01.08.2027. Für die ersten 48 Monate werden unverbindliche Kalkulations- und Wertungsmengen von 4.490.606 Standard-eGK G2.1, 1.924.545 rPVC-eGK G2.1, 3.812.299 PIN-/PUKBriefen, 381.230 Sendungen mit Zustellident, 6.415,151 Abrechnungseinheiten für die technische DV- und/oder UPOC-Freimachung zu je 1.000 Sendungen, 5.132.121 beigefügten Hauptflyern (für die Angebotswertung: Organspendeflyer) und 2.420.000 zusammen mit einem Hauptflyer beigefügten kassenindividuellen Zusatzflyern zugrunde gelegt. Diese Mengenangaben begründen im Rahmen des ausgeschriebenen Dauerschuldverhältnisses weder eine Mindestabnahmemenge noch eine vertragsbeendende Höchstmenge. Die bei Vertragsschluss vereinbarten Netto-Einheitspreise bleiben bis einschließlich 31.07.2031 unverändert. Ab dem 01.08.2031 werden die erfassten Einheitspreise im Abstand von jeweils 24 Monaten nach der vertraglich festgelegten Preisänderungsklausel angepasst. Für physische Nachfolgegenerationen der Gesundheitskarten gilt das hierfür gesondert geregelte Preisbildungs-, Prüf-, Nachweis- und Freigabeverfahren. Die Verträge haben kein festes Enddatum und bestehen bis zu einer wirksamen Kündigung fort. title: Ganzheitliche Unterstützung bei der Messung, Qualitätssicherung, Auswertung und wissenschaftlichen Einordnung klimawirksamer halogenierter Spurengase an der GAW-Station Zugspitze unter Verwendung eines MEDUSA-Systems im AGAGE-Kontext
description: Ziel des Projektes ist die fachliche Unterstützung des Umweltbundesamtes bei der Einrichtung, Inbetriebnahme, dem Anlaufbetrieb sowie der wissenschaftlich-technischen Etablierung eines MEDUSA-Messsystems zur kontinuierlichen Bestimmung langlebiger klimawirksamer halogenierter Spurengase (insbesondere FCKW) an der GAW-Station Zugspitze. . Der Auftragnehmende erbringt seine Leistungen unterstützend und begleitend in enger Abstimmung mit dem Auftraggeber. Die Verantwortung für den Messbetrieb verbleibt beim Umweltbundesamt. Der Auftragnehmende übernimmt insbesondere unterstützende Tätigkeiten in folgenden Bereichen: - Unterstützung bei der Installation und Inbetriebnahme des MEDUSA-Systems - Unterstützung bei der Konfiguration der Hard- und Software einschließlich der Aus-wertesoftware GCWerks gemäß AGAGE-Standards - Unterstützung bei der Bereitstellung und Implementierung geeigneter Kalibrier- und Referenzstandards für den kontinuierlichen Messbetrieb - fachliche Begleitung der Anlaufphase - Unterstützung bei der wissenschaftlichen Auswertung und Einordnung der quali-tätsgesicherten Messdaten. . Ziel ist es, gemeinsam mit dem Auftraggeber einen stabilen, qualitätsgesicherten und AGAGE-kompatiblen Betrieb des MEDUSA-Systems an der GAW-Station Zugspitze zu etablieren und zugleich einen nachhaltigen Kompetenzaufbau beim Stationspersonal zu gewährleisten.

title: Yliopisto-lehden painopalvelun kilpailutus
description: Yliopisto-lehden painopalvelun kilpailutus Hankinnan kohteena on Helsingin yliopiston julkaiseman Yliopisto-lehden painopalvelu. Palveluun kuuluu lehden painaminen tilaajan toimittaman painovalmiin aineiston perusteella sekä tässä palvelukuvauksessa määritellyt siihen liittyvät muut työvaiheet. Lehdestä julkaistaan vuosittain arviolta 8 numeroa. Yhden numeron arvioitu painosmäärä on 8 000- 40 000 kpl kappaletta. Lehden koko on B5 ja laajuus 64 sivua + kannet tai 72 sivua + kannet. Lehti on stiftattu. Tilaaja voi sopimuskauden aikana muuttaa yksittäisen lehden numeroiden sivumäärää, painosmäärää tai muita teknisiä ominaisuuksia. Muutokset hinnoitellaan tarjouspyynnössä ilmoitettujen yksikköhintojen perusteella. Palveluntuottajan pitää pystyä toteuttamaan eri painosmäärillä ja sivumäärillä tilattavia lehtinumeroita niin, että painotyön ja jälkikäsittelyn laatu pysyvät hyvinä ja sovittu aikataulu pitää. Konerikko- tai muiden häiriötilanteiden varalle pitää olla laatustandardit täyttävät varajärjestelyt. Vedosliikenne toteutetaan sähköisesti, mutta tarvittaessa paperivedoksen pitää olla mahdollinen 12 tunnin kuluessa. Palveluntarjoajan pitää pystyä tuottamaan näköislehti omana palvelunaan ja lisäksi palveluntarjoajan pitää pystyä tuottamaan sanahaulla varustettu näköislehtiarkisto vuodesta 2013 lähtien kuluitta tai siirtämään jo olemassa oleva arkisto kuluitta omaan palveluunsa. Kaikki painamiseen normaalisti kuuluvat työvaiheet pre-pressistä jälkikiäsittelyyn tulee sisällyttää ilmoitettuun painamisen hintaan. Muut palvelut pitää ilmoittaa hintaliitteessä pyydetyllä tavalla. Tarkempi kuvaus hankittavasta palvelusta on luettavissa liitteestä 1 Palvelunkuvaus. Helsingin yliopisto valitsee yhden toimittajan, jonka kanssa tehdään sopimus yhden (1) vuoden kiinteälle sopimuskaudelle, jonka jälkeen sopimusta voidaan jatkaa kahden vuoden optiokaudelle yksi vuosi kerrallaan (1 + 1 vuotta).,

title: Strategic Circular Value Chains Outlook
description: Strategic Circular Value Chains Outlook Background and objective of the procurement The circular economy discourse is already well-served by global material flow measurements, circularity indicators, policy stocktakes, thematic studies and examples of existing business models. This procurement is not intended to duplicate those products or measure how circular the global economy or policy landscape is. The Outlook will instead leverage a combination of synthesis and foresight capabilities to provide forward-looking, decision-oriented intelligence on how geopolitical, geoeconomic, regulatory, technological, trade and investment shifts – as reflections of a set of core megatrends – are changing the strategic relevance of and are generating the most commercially relevant opportunities in key international circular value chains, informing leading investment sector and business leaders on what the key economic opportunities are and how to position themselves in light of the projected developments – in turn informing policymakers on the most critical bottlenecks. The Outlook will scan globally for developments tied to a set of core megatrends and a larger set of resulting and parallel sub-trends and pivotal events that influence our relationship with CRMs and which as a result alter the strategic context for key circular economy value chains and the associated commercial opportunities. Its applied analysis will have a global framing and a global focus but also consider the perspective of ODA-eligible partner countries as well as links to the EU and Global Gateway. The intention is to establish a flagship report series, with subsequent editions published at each subsequent World Circular Economy Forum (hereafter the ‘WCEF’) using the concept developed under this assignment. The first report shall establish a recognisable publication architecture and repeatable methodology suitable for use in subsequent editions, along with pre-defined sectors and priority themes. The concept shall explain how future editions could retain this stable analytical foundation while refreshing world events, weak signals, value-chain applications, cases and recommendations to remain relevant and topical, ensuring that the report has a sufficient level of novelty and innovation to justify annual publication. Apart from the ASEAN report commissioned under Section 3.3, production, updating and launch of subsequent editions are outside this procurement; this procurement entails no commitment to commission them or retain the same supplier. The ASEAN report shall share the Outlook brand and analytical architecture and constitute an associated regional output between full editions (conceptually ‘1.5’ between ‘1.0’ and ‘2.0’), rather than a second full global edition. Final publication titles and numbering shall be agreed with Sitra. The recurring core question is this: starting from a comprehensive analysis of core megatrends today, where and why is circular economy becoming strategically important, and how should businesses and investors pivot to optimally direct their resources? The first report shall address the following questions, which shall also form part of the reusable concept for subsequent editions: • What are the most central megatrends (particularly geostrategic trends) and associated trends and events that impact CRM futures and our relationship with these materials? • Resulting from these trends and events, o which resources and circular value chains are gaining strategic importance, and how can these markets be expected to develop? o which business opportunities within these markets related to circular solutions and business models show credible signs of developing maturity and market uptake, investability and scalability (accounting for international trade, including with the EU) when looking ahead, where are the most opportune areas for supporting commercial deployment and which bottlenecks remain unresolved? o how should investors and the private sector position themselves to take advantage of the markets expected to emerge? o What opportunities are already connected to and could be further unlocked through the EU Global Gateway? The assignment requires an integrated combination of circular economy and material-systems expertise (including in relation to CRMs, especially related to secondary CRMs), geopolitical and geoeconomic analysis and foresight capabilities, as well as trade and investment analysis, commercial intelligence, business writing, sector-specific in-depth knowledge and insights on both ODA country contexts and EU policy & Global Europe, data analysis, editorial production and data visualisation. Assignment The supplier shall develop the reusable concept, methodology and publication architecture for the Strategic Circular Value Chains Outlook series and research, write, visualise and support publication of the first report, including delivery of its launch package, in close collaboration with Sitra. The procurement commissions the first global Outlook report and an associated short ASEAN report. Final delivery of the first report and launch package is set for 1 April 2027; the ASEAN report shall be delivered publication-ready by 10 June 2027. The assignment ends with delivery of this report and its agreed editable materials and does not include production or launch support for subsequent full editions or attendance at the October 2027 forum. The assignment covers three output packages: 1. Inception and series design 2. First Strategic Circular Value Chains Outlook report 3. ASEAN-focused 2027 Outlook report and roadshow The procurement is described in more detail in Appendix 1 to the invitation to tender.,

title: Daugiabučių namų kvartalo tarp Strėvos, Nemuno, Sulupės ir Minijos gatvių Klaipėdoje sutvarkymo projektavimo paslaugų pirkimų RINKOS KONSULTACIJA.
description: Daugiabučių namų kvartalo tarp Strėvos, Nemuno, Sulupės ir Minijos gatvių Klaipėdoje sutvarkymo projektavimo paslaugų pirkimų RINKOS KONSULTACIJA. Rinkos konsultacija skelbiama iki pirkimo pradžios. Rinkos konsultacija nėra skelbimas apie pirkimą ar išankstinis skelbimas apie pirkimą. Šios rinkos konsultacijos paskelbimu dalyviai nėra kviečiami varžytis dėl pirkimo sutarties. Dalyvavimas rinkos konsultacijoje yra neatlygintinas, nesuteikiantis pirmenybinio statuso dalyvaujant pirkime. Jokios išlaidos dalyviams neatlyginamos, kompensacijos nemokamos, dalyvavimas rinkos konsultacijoje neturi įtakos ir nesuteikia dalyviui pirmenybės viešiesiems pirkimams, kurie bus skelbiami ateityje, ar jų rezultatams. Rinkos konsultacijos tikslas - informuoti tiekėjus apie planuojamą pirkimą, išsiaiškinti įvairius su pirkimo objektu susijusius klausimus, pasiruošti pirkimui įvertinat pateiktus dokumentus.

title: Netherlands – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Architectenselectie ver-/nieuwbouw Montessori Vaklyceum
description: De opdracht betreft de architectonische uitwerking van de vernieuwbouw, inclusief de buitenruimte, van het Montessori Vaklyceum aan de Vondellaan 83 in Groningen. De opgave omvat de voorbereiding, het ontwerp en de verdere uitwerking van een toekomstbestendige onderwijshuisvesting, passend bij de ambities van Openbaar Onderwijs Groningen en de gemeente Groningen. De vernieuwbouw bestaat uit het behoud van circa 1.300 m² van het bestaande gebouw uit 1968 en de realisatie van circa 4.000 m² nieuwbouw, gezamenlijk circa 5.300 m² BVO. Het bestaande bouwdeel uit 1968 vertegenwoordigt een belangrijke cultuurhistorische waarde en vormt daarmee niet slechts een bestaand gebouw dat behouden blijft, maar een wezenlijk vertrekpunt voor de ontwerpopgave. Naast het gebouw maakt ook de directe buitenruimte onderdeel uit van de ontwerpopgave.

title: Stage 1 – Guardrail and Repairs Cape Breton Highway, Cape Breton Highlands National Park
description: 5P468-26-0302/A Stage 1 – Guardrail and Repairs Cape Breton Highway, Cape Breton Highlands National Park BIDS RECEIVED BY FAX AND EMAIL WILL BE ACCEPTED AS OFFICIAL. PARKS CANADA IS NOT CURRENTLY ACCEPTING BIDS VIA SAP ARIBA, YOU MUST SUBMIT YOUR BID VIA FAX OR EMAIL AS INDICATED IN THE SOLICITATION DOCUMENT. BIDS RECEIVED IN-PERSON OR BY COURIER WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. The only acceptable email address for responses to the bid solicitation is soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca. Bids submitted by email directly to the Contracting Authority or to any email address other than soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca will not be accepted. The only acceptable facsimile for responses to bid solicitations is 1-855-983-1808. The maximum email file size that Parks Canada is capable of receiving is 15 megabytes. The Bidder is responsible for any failure attributable to the transmission or receipt of the emailed bid due to file size. The Bidder should be cognisant of the size of the email as a whole, and not only the attachments. Please take into consideration that some attachments, when sent, may be resized during the email transfer. If the email size is too large, the Bidder should send the bid in multiple emails properly labeled with the solicitation number, project name, and indicate how many emails are included (ex. 1 of 2). Emails with links to bid documents will not be accepted. Bid documents must be sent as email attachments. This is a two stage selection process. Bidders responding to this selection process are requested to submit a bid in two stages. This posting is the first stage (Stage One) of a two-stage solicitation process: the first stage will evaluate the qualifications of all interested suppliers; the second stage (Stage Two) will invite the qualified suppliers to provide a financial bid on the project based on the specifications and drawings. Upon award of contract in Stage Two the pre-qualification list will expire and will not be used in any other solicitation. The qualification list will expire within 180 days or upon award of a contract in Stage Two, whichever is earlier, and the prequalification list will not be used in any other solicitation. Following the evaluation of the submissions of Stage One, bidders will be advised of their qualification result and the status of the tender. Parks Canada reserves the right to re-issue Stage One via a /B solicitation if it is determined there is insufficient competition to proceed with Stage Two. Bidders that have qualified in Stage One /A will not be required to resubmit on the Stage One /B. Bidders that failed to demonstrate compliance on the Stage One /A may resubmit and will be considered in Stage One /B. Stage Two Bidders will be provided an INVITATION TO TENDER (ITT) for the financial evaluation in relation to the specifications and drawings. Please note that the ITT used in Stage 2 of this process will be a Two-Envelope ITT with (1) an Indigenous Participation Plan (IPP) and (2) a price evaluation component. LIST OF PRE-QUALIFIED BIDDERS: A list of pre-qualified bidders from Stage One will not be released. Contract award notice of the successful bidder of Stage Two will be posted on http://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities PARTNER WITH ANOTHER BUSINESS: Potential and interested sub-contractors are invited to add their company’s name under the section “Partner with another business” REQUIREMENT This project is for the supply and installation of 1500 meters of curved W guard rail as noted below including the supply of the new rails, required hardware, reflectors as well as the removal of the old rails and all labour. The replacement locations are noted but are generally from the top of North Mountain heading east. In this section there will be an allowance for 5 units for the removal and replacement of 5 guardrail posts, blocking, and hardware which will be selected by Parks Canada. The locations of the rails (5 posts to be determined) are noted below. Also included in this scope of work is the installation of paved gutters for run off control along the Cabot Trail. We require installation of paved gutter on the north and south bound sides off the halfway brook bridge to control the number of washouts and rocks on the paved road surface. The north side is 195 meters, and the south side is 50 meters off paved gutter needed. The final piece of work involved is the installation of R100 rock and R25 rock to be placed on an eroded roadside bank near Effie’s Brook in Ingonish, NS the coordinates where the erosion issue starts and stops. Start: (46.8550898, -60.4542163) & stop: (46.8552184, -60.4552864). Stone is to be placed with machinery with R100 interlocked with a top layer of R25 stone. To assist with bonding and insurance requirements, this project is estimated at a value between $100,001 > $250,000, Taxes extra. PERIOD OF CONTRACT / DELIVERY DATE Contractor must perform and complete the Work no later than March 31, 2027. ENQUIRIES All enquiries of a technical and contractual nature are to be submitted to the Contracting Authority. Enquiries regarding this solicitation must be submitted in writing and should be received no later than five (5) business days prior to the date set for solicitation closing to allow sufficient time to provide a response. Enquiries received after that time may result in an answer NOT being provided. INFORMATION National Parks Regulations require that all work is to be performed in accordance with the ordinances, laws, rules and regulations set out in the National Park Act. Bidders that consider themselves qualified to provide this Work and intend to submit bids on this project should obtain documents from the Government Electronic Tendering Service through the Government of Canada tendering service at http://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities. Addenda, when issued, will be available from the Government of Canada tendering service. Bidders that elect to base their bids on documents obtained from other sources do so at their own risk. Late submissions will not be considered. The Crown retains the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. Parks Canada has made every effort to provide equivalent documents in both official languages, however, if you find any discrepancies between the English and French documents, please notify the contract officer listed in this opportunity as soon as possible so that we can rectify the situation.

buyer: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
title: Consultancy framework agreement for formulation, appraisal and review of Danish development cooperation programmes and projects
description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark (MFA) is in the process of streamlining the management of its development cooperation. Part of this effort concerns the simplification of the procurement process of key consultancy services relating to development cooperation. Consultancy contracts are currently procured individually by the case worker responsible for the programme or project. Case workers are MFA staff from MFA Services at Home and Services Abroad. They are responsible for the procurement process of individual contracts which is often lengthy, and can have implications on programme and project implementation timelines. Moreover, the fragmentation of the process makes it difficult to use the feedback from case workers on the fulfilment of the assignments. This makes it challenging to harvest learning from past performance and ensure a sustained quality of services. It is in this context that the MFA wishes to consolidate the procurement of consultancy services through a framework agreement with multiple contractors. The streamlining of the management of Danish development cooperation entailed a revision of the Danida – Aid Management Guidelines (AMG). This foresees a delegation of key tasks to external consultants, primarily appraisals, and thereby an expected rise in the number of consultancy services to be requested. It is therefore an opportune time to seek a more streamlined procurement process of consultancy services. The AMG’s Bilateral Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/guidelines-for-programmes-projects-country-strategic-frameworks-and-hard-earmarked-multilat-support) and Financial Management Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/financial-management) constitute the basic set of procedures for all Danish bilateral development cooperation. The guidelines outline the processes and requirements for the preparation, formulation, quality assurance, approval, implementation, completion and closure of Danish bilateral programmes and projects. The purpose of the framework agreement is to make the MFA procurement of key consultancy services relating to Danish bilateral development programmes and projects more effective and efficient by ensuring quick access to relevant specialists, reducing the procurement time for assignments, and improving the quality of services provided. The objective of the framework agreement is to have a contractual set-up between the MFA and a number of contractors who can provide, upon demand and in a timely manner, the required expertise and service quality for the formulation, appraisal and review of Danish bilateral development programmes and projects. The objective of each assignment and the required outputs will be described in the Terms of Reference, which will be part of the Delivery Contract for the individual assignment. The Framework Agreement solely covers Denmark’s bilateral development cooperation programmes and projects. Therefore, the scope of work of consultancy services solely pertains to Official Development Assistance (ODA) funds. The framework agreement is divided into two lots that reflect the thematic areas and priorities of Denmark’s Strategy for Development Cooperation: Lot 1: Climate, environment, private sector and financing. Lot 2: Governance, fragility, and migration. The framework agreement will require the provision of the following services pertaining to the design and implementation phases of bilateral development cooperation programmes, namely: Formulation of bilateral programmes and projects. This may include preparatory work in the formulation process if and as needed. Appraisal of the design of bilateral programmes and projects as a quality assurance milestone prior to approval. This includes external appraisals led by the consultant and early appraisals of larger or high-risk programmes/projects led by LÆRING. Review of bilateral programmes and projects under implementation. This can span inception, midterm and technical reviews covering the full implementation period of the programme/project as part of the MFA unit’s monitoring and reporting cycle. Reviews do not have the same scope of work, methodology and methods as an evaluation. The MFA’s definition of appraisal, review and evaluation services is aligned with the definitions provided by OECD/DAC (https://one.oecd.org/document/DCD/DAC/EV(2022)2/en/pdf). The content of the services will vary and be defined by the MFA in the specific Terms of Reference for each individual assignment. The following themes and types of services will not be part of the framework agreement: Research and university partnerships. Training programmes and tracer studies. Culture. NGO strategic partnership agreements with the MFA (SPA agreements). Core support to multilateral organisations as described in Danish Organisation Strategies. Strategic Sector Cooperation. Audit assignments. Legal assessments. Monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning (MEAL) unit contracts and multi-year MEAL technical assistance. Evaluations. Tender process consultancies. Please refer to the Consultancy Framework Agreement and Appendix 1 Scope of Services for a more detailed description of the object of the procurement.

title: Greece – Cleaning and sanitation services in urban or rural areas, and related services – Υπηρεσίες αποκομιδής απορριμμάτων και καθαριότητας κοινόχρηστων χώρων Δήμου Άνδρου
description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι : • Καθαρισμός και ευπρεπισμός κοινοχρήστων χώρων των οικισμών του Δήμου, όπου προβλέπονται να γίνουν όλες οι απαιτούμενες εργασίες περισυλλογής ελεύθερων απορριμμάτων – ασπρίσματα – εργασίες πρασίνου - καθαρισμοί –και γενικός ευπρεπισμός των κοινόχρηστων χώρων, των δρόμων, πεζοδρόμων και πλατειών των οικισμών του Δήμου. • Αποψιλώσεις – κλαδέματα – καθαρισμοί από αυτοφυή βλάστηση, δημοτικών οδών, μονοπατιών και κοινόχρηστων χώρων στις εκτός σχεδίου περιοχές του Δήμου. (Η επιλογή των προς καθαρισμό περιοχών θα γίνεται από τον αρμόδιο αντιδήμαρχο, με βασικά κριτήρια την πυροπροστασία περιμετρικά των οικισμών και την ασφαλή διέλευση οχημάτων και πεζών) • Περισυλλογή των ειδικών κάδων κομποστοποίησης και αντικατάσταση τους με κενούς, σε επιλεγμένα σημεία των οικισμών Όρμου Κορθίου και Κορθίου, σύμφωνα με το πρόγραμμα κομποστοποίησης οργανικών αποβλήτων (υπολείμματα κουζίνας) του Δήμου Άνδρου. Για την εκτέλεση των ανωτέρω υπηρεσιών, ο ανάδοχος θα πρέπει να διαθέτει: Α) κατάλληλο προσωπικό: • 14 εργάτες καθαριότητας Β) απαιτούμενο υλικοτεχνικό εξοπλισμό: • Σακούλες απορριμμάτων μαύρες μεγάλες 120Χ120 εκ. & σακούλες μικρές για τα καλαθάκια • Ασβέστες για το άσπρισμα των οδών • Λοιπά υλικά και εργαλεία (βούρτσες, σκούπες, καρότσια ,κλπ) για τον καθαρισμό των οδών • Υλικοτεχνικό εξοπλισμό για τις εργασίες αποψίλωσης και κλαδεμάτων (χορτοκοπτικά, φτυάρια, πριόνια χειρός και βενζίνης, τσάπες, σκάλες κλπ) • Μέσα ατομικά προστασίας για τους εργαζόμενους. Για τις λοιπές ανάγκες του έργου, όπως περιγράφονται στην παρούσα, ο Δήμος θα παραχωρεί στον ανάδοχο κατάλληλα οχήματά του, αναλόγως των αναγκών και της διαθεσιμότητας. Ο ανάδοχος για την εκτέλεση των ανωτέρω εργασιών υποχρεούται να απασχολεί εργάτες καθαριότητας με εξαρτημένη σχέση εργασίας και με πλήρες ωράριο εργασίας, ως ακολούθως: - από την υπογραφή της σύμβασης και για χρονική διάρκεια 18 μηνών : 468 ημέρες x 14 εργάτες καθαριότητας = 6.552 ημερομίσθια με πλήρες ωράριο εργασίας, για τις εργασίες αποκομιδής απορριμμάτων και καθαριότητας κοινοχρήστων χώρων Δήμου Άνδρου(6 ήμερη απασχόληση). ΣΥΝΟΛΟ ημερομισθίων: 6.552. Η αρχική διάρκεια της σύμβασης ορίζεται σε δεκαοκτώ (18) μήνες από την ημερομηνία έναρξης ισχύος της, με ανώτατο αρχικό φυσικό αντικείμενο 6.552 ημερομισθίων πλήρους απασχόλησης και ανώτατη αρχική συμβατική αξία 511.711,20 € χωρίς ΦΠΑ. Η Αναθέτουσα Αρχή διατηρεί δικαίωμα προαίρεσης, το οποίο μπορεί να ασκηθεί, εν όλω ή εν μέρει, με αιτιολογημένη απόφαση του αρμοδίου οργάνου πριν από τη λήξη της αρχικής συμβατικής διάρκειας, εφόσον εξακολουθούν να υφίστανται ανάγκες παροχής των ίδιων υπηρεσιών και εξασφαλίζεται η απαιτούμενη δημοσιονομική κάλυψη. Το δικαίωμα προαίρεσης αφορά πρόσθετη διάρκεια έως εννέα (9) μήνες, πρόσθετο φυσικό αντικείμενο έως 3.276 ημερομίσθια πλήρους απασχόλησης και πρόσθετη αξία έως 255.855,60 € χωρίς ΦΠΑ, ήτοι έως ποσοστό 50% του αρχικού φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου. Σε περίπτωση πλήρους άσκησης της προαίρεσης, η συνολική διάρκεια της σύμβασης δεν μπορεί να υπερβεί τους είκοσι επτά (27) μήνες, ο συνολικός αριθμός ημερομισθίων τα 9.828 και η συνολική αξία τα 767.566,80 € χωρίς ΦΠΑ. Η άσκηση της προαίρεσης δεν μπορεί να μεταβάλει τη συνολική φύση της σύμβασης και αφορά αποκλειστικά τις υπηρεσίες και τις τεχνικές προδιαγραφές που περιγράφονται εξαρχής στα συμβατικά τεύχη. Ο Δήμος δύναται να αναπροσαρμόζει την κατανομή των ημερομισθίων τόσο ανά Δημοτική Ενότητα (χωρικά), όσο και ανά χρονική περίοδο (χρονικά), αναλόγως των αναγκών του Δήμου. Η παρεχόμενη υπηρεσία κατατάσσεται στους ακόλουθους κωδικούς του Κοινού Λεξιλογίου δημοσίων συμβάσεων (CPV): 90600000-3 : “Υπηρεσίες καθαριότητας και εξυγίανσης σε αστικές ή αγροτικές ζώνες, καθώς και συναφείς υπηρεσίες” Αναλυτική περιγραφή του φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου της σύμβασης δίδεται στο ΠΑΡΑΡΤΗΜΑ Α της παρούσας διακήρυξης. (αρ. μελέτης: 10/2026) Η σύμβαση θα ανατεθεί με το κριτήριο της πλέον συμφέρουσας από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, βάσει της τιμής.

title: Denmark – Foreign economic-aid-related services – Consultancy framework agreement for formulation, appraisal and review of Danish development cooperation programmes and projects
description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark (MFA) is in the process of streamlining the management of its development cooperation. Part of this effort concerns the simplification of the procurement process of key consultancy services relating to development cooperation. Consultancy contracts are currently procured individually by the case worker responsible for the programme or project. Case workers are MFA staff from MFA Services at Home and Services Abroad. They are responsible for the procurement process of individual contracts which is often lengthy, and can have implications on programme and project implementation timelines. Moreover, the fragmentation of the process makes it difficult to use the feedback from case workers on the fulfilment of the assignments. This makes it challenging to harvest learning from past performance and ensure a sustained quality of services. It is in this context that the MFA wishes to consolidate the procurement of consultancy services through a framework agreement with multiple contractors. The streamlining of the management of Danish development cooperation entailed a revision of the Danida – Aid Management Guidelines (AMG). This foresees a delegation of key tasks to external consultants, primarily appraisals, and thereby an expected rise in the number of consultancy services to be requested. It is therefore an opportune time to seek a more streamlined procurement process of consultancy services. The AMG’s Bilateral Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/guidelines-for-programmes-projects-country-strategic-frameworks-and-hard-earmarked-multilat-support) and Financial Management Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/financial-management) constitute the basic set of procedures for all Danish bilateral development cooperation. The guidelines outline the processes and requirements for the preparation, formulation, quality assurance, approval, implementation, completion and closure of Danish bilateral programmes and projects. The purpose of the framework agreement is to make the MFA procurement of key consultancy services relating to Danish bilateral development programmes and projects more effective and efficient by ensuring quick access to relevant specialists, reducing the procurement time for assignments, and improving the quality of services provided. The objective of the framework agreement is to have a contractual set-up between the MFA and a number of contractors who can provide, upon demand and in a timely manner, the required expertise and service quality for the formulation, appraisal and review of Danish bilateral development programmes and projects. The objective of each assignment and the required outputs will be described in the Terms of Reference, which will be part of the Delivery Contract for the individual assignment. The Framework Agreement solely covers Denmark’s bilateral development cooperation programmes and projects. Therefore, the scope of work of consultancy services solely pertains to Official Development Assistance (ODA) funds. The framework agreement is divided into two lots that reflect the thematic areas and priorities of Denmark’s Strategy for Development Cooperation: Lot 1: Climate, environment, private sector and financing. Lot 2: Governance, fragility, and migration. The framework agreement will require the provision of the following services pertaining to the design and implementation phases of bilateral development cooperation programmes, namely: Formulation of bilateral programmes and projects. This may include preparatory work in the formulation process if and as needed. Appraisal of the design of bilateral programmes and projects as a quality assurance milestone prior to approval. This includes external appraisals led by the consultant and early appraisals of larger or high-risk programmes/projects led by LÆRING. Review of bilateral programmes and projects under implementation. This can span inception, midterm and technical reviews covering the full implementation period of the programme/project as part of the MFA unit’s monitoring and reporting cycle. Reviews do not have the same scope of work, methodology and methods as an evaluation. The MFA’s definition of appraisal, review and evaluation services is aligned with the definitions provided by OECD/DAC (https://one.oecd.org/document/DCD/DAC/EV(2022)2/en/pdf). The content of the services will vary and be defined by the MFA in the specific Terms of Reference for each individual assignment. The following themes and types of services will not be part of the framework agreement: Research and university partnerships. Training programmes and tracer studies. Culture. NGO strategic partnership agreements with the MFA (SPA agreements). Core support to multilateral organisations as described in Danish Organisation Strategies. Strategic Sector Cooperation. Audit assignments. Legal assessments. Monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning (MEAL) unit contracts and multi-year MEAL technical assistance. Evaluations. Tender process consultancies. Please refer to the Consultancy Framework Agreement and Appendix 1 Scope of Services for a more detailed description of the object of the procurement.

title: Norway – Systems and technical consultancy services – Procurement of consultancy services - Product area manager for the land animal product area.
description: The objective of the procurement is to strengthen the Norwegian Food Safety Authority ́s work in product development through an experienced consultant who, through the role of product area manager, shall support the establishment and further development of the Land animal product area. Landdyr product area currently consists of four product teams with different areas of responsibility where there are dependencies between the teams and functions in other parts of the organisation. The area of responsibility is broad and comprises everything from digital inspection systems for land animals, a meat control system on slaughterhouses, personnel approval, use of veterinary medicines, as well as central registers. Over time, teams have built up considerable domain knowledge and worked independently with their assignments, but there is a need to appear uniform, and together ensure effects across which contribute to increased food safety, animal health and animal welfare. The consultant ́s main task is to coordinate and support this cooperation, and together with the product managers contribute to establishing clear frameworks for organisation, management and interaction in the product area. The work shall build on the teams ́ existing competence, experience and ownership of the domain. The assignment involves supporting the development of a common area strategy with clear aims and priorities in line with the organisation's strategic ambitions. The consultant shall contribute to establishing good forms of work for overall decisions, handling dependencies and follow-up of the area ́s results and effects in cooperation with the product managers, the management group in the Development Department and other relevant interested parties. A central goal of the assignment is to strengthen the product area ́s ability to develop a common direction and cooperate across time. The consultant shall therefore emphasise the involvement, transfer of competence and ownership of the existing product managers, so that the Norwegian Food Safety Authority can continue the product area management after the assignment has concluded.

title: Facet Coater
description: For over two decades, the Canadian Photonics Fabrication Centre (CPFC) at the National Research Council of Canada (NRC) has operated as a mission-critical facility supporting Canada’s photonics and semiconductor innovation ecosystem. The CPFC provides advanced fabrication and metrology services for both internal research programs and external clients, enabling the development and production of cutting-edge photonic devices used in telecommunications, sensing, and quantum technologies. Photonic devices are critical pieces of hardware for high-performance computing in various innovative fields such as artificial intelligence (AI), data centres, automotive LiDARs (Light Detection and Ranging), biomedical, aerospace; security, and quantum industry/applications. The global market for compound semiconductor foundry services is growing rapidly, presenting niche opportunities and challenges for Canada. Limited access to compound semiconductor foundry services poses several challenges to develop, successfully introduce, and supply new products in an increasingly competitive marketplace. Photonic devices fabricated on InP wafers must undergo several “back-end” steps before dicing and packaging, adding time and cost if the assembled parts are then found to be defective. This project will establish the capability at CPFC to deliver known good die (KGD) to clients, to reduce time and cost for new product introduction (NPI). To provide KGD, a new clean room (ISO 6) will be constructed (retrofit of a current facility) to house numerous automated tools, such as Dual Ion Beam Sputter Deposition (DIBS) Laser Facet Coating Systems. This project will address an immediate client need for timely introduction of new products into a competitive marketplace.
